defects.description: The balance accumulates parsed floats, so three postings of 0.10 do not sum to 0.30 and two ledgers can disagree at the cent.

trigger.input: const l = createLedger(); l.post('a','0.10'); l.post('b','0.10'); l.post('c','0.10'); [l.balance(), l.balance() === 0.3]

defects.why_missed: The suite adds amounts that are exact in binary (10, 25, 12.50, 7.25), so every assertion holds; the failure needs a value like 0.10 that binary floats cannot represent.

defects.description: formatCents rounds through Math.round on a binary float, so amounts ending in 5 at the third decimal round down instead of half up.
defects.why_missed: The one half-up case in the suite (10.125) happens to be exactly representable in binary; only inputs such as 1.005 expose that the rounding happens on an approximation.
